title: Mera bhaiyya akbar salamat rahe
body:
Mera bhaiyya akbar salamat rahe
Madine me sughra ki hai ye dua mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe, Dua meri sun le aye mere khuda Mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe..
1- Ajab khwab dekha hai hairan hoon *2 museebat zada hun pareshan hoon *2
Rahe khair se mere pyare chacha, mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe
<<MINI>>
Madine me sughra ki hai ye dua mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
2- Mere khwab me kuch haqeeqat na ho *2 qayamat se pehle qayamat na ho *2
Na ho choor zakhmo se baba mera, mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe!!
<<MINI>>
Madine me sughra ki hai ye dua mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe.
<<DIVIDER>>
3- Bichhadne se asgher ke dil hai udas *2 Najane wo kab ayega ayega mere paas *2
Humakta rahe bhaiyya Asgher mera, mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe!!
<<MINI>>
Madine me sughra ki hai ye dua mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe

<<MINI>>
Madine me sughra ki hai ye dua mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe

<<MINI>>
Madine me sughra ki hai ye dua mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe

<<MINI>>
Madine me sughra ki hai ye dua mera bhaiyya akber salamat rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
